THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: KDS/KUN/04/07/016/04/39.
Reference no of the ministry of Land and Land
deveiopment: 4/3/15/2012/VE/187.
I, hereby notice under sub section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land below is needed for the public purpose and will be acquired as intended by the Government.
Description of the Land:

Furthermore, the nature of the ownership of the lands, the details of the facts for saking for compensation, the amount of compensation and the way the amount of compensation has been calculated should be included in the two copies 18th May, 2016. The documents of such details should be forwarded in duplicate at the examination, deeds regarding the ownership should be forwarded at the examination.
